module rtlpp_00908 (clk, reset, loadseed_i, seed_i, number_o);
    input clk;
    input reset;
    input loadseed_i;
    input [31:0] seed_i;
    output [31:0] number_o;

    reg [31:0] number_o;

    reg [42:0] LFSR_reg;
    reg [36:0] CASR_reg;

    // CASR Logic

        if (!reset) begin
            CASR_reg <= 1;
        end else begin
            if (loadseed_i) begin
                CASR_varCASR[36:32] <= 0;
                CASR_varCASR[31:0] <= seed_i;
                CASR_reg <= CASR_varCASR;

                LFSR_varLFSR[17] = LFSR_varLFSR[16];

        end else begin
            number_o <= LFSR_reg[31:0] ^ CASR_reg[31:0];
